Second dated record: "2026-02-27 ... AL KUNUZ POULTRY LLC CLOSE TYPE SHEDS MONITORING WITH CONTROLLER- BANGALORE ACC INBLR4, India MUSCAT, OMAN 85369090 1068242" (B/L 1068242). Counter: page states "Total Shipments 398 Records detected", "Trading Partners 41", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-27"; rows actually visible on the free page: 5 shipment rows (2 outbound to Oman, 3 inbound from Sri Lanka/Japan). Related entity ABIS EXPORTS (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED (same Indamara/Pendri address) shows "Total Shipments 1266 Records detected", latest 2025-07-30, with outbound rows e.g. "2025-07-26 ABIS EXPORTS (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED FARMCHEMIE MANUFACTURERS(PRIVATE)LIMITED ... Colombo, Sri Lanka 39232990 3920803" and "2025-07-25 ... POULTREE LIGHTING CO., LTD ... SHANGHAI, CHINA 85044090 3477660"; 5 rows visible of 1266 claimed. Note: the bulk of both entities' visible rows are IMPORTS (feed premix, DL-methionine, soybean oil, machinery), so the 398/1266 counters are import-dominated, not export volumes.

note: Declared HS 230910 (dog/cat food retail packs) does NOT match the observed trade: actual codes seen are 04071100 (broiler hatching eggs), 85369090 (electrical controllers), 23099090 (feed premix, import), 15071000 (crude degummed soybean oil, import), 39232990 (PP bags), 85044090 (power supplies).
